channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Announcing the 2026 Recipient of the Steve Fairfield Memorial Award
item.description: AeroFlexx earned top honors for its mono-material package that reduces plastic use and improves recyclability. The award highlights continued growth and innovation in flexible packaging across CPG categories.

item.title: RäFoods Names John Rota CMO
item.description: Rota joins at a key inflection point to translate RäFoods’ Living Nutrition philosophy into measurable performance. His role will focus on brand strategy, go-to-market execution and scalable growth.

item.title: Swicy Sauces Spark Category Growth
item.description: From chili crisp ketchup and smoky chipotle mustard to spicy ranch and pickle-forward mashups, brands leaned into heat and crossover flavor. Cleaner labels and alternative sweeteners such as avocado oil and allulose signal the next phase of condiment competition.

item.title: Taylor Farms Expands Into Protein-Focused Line
item.description: Taylor Farms rolls out 11 protein-forward products spanning salad kits, bowls and snacks. The line taps growing demand for high-protein, convenient fresh foods.

item.title: Dainty Foods to Build Ohio Facility
item.description: The new 250,000sq-ft facility will produce up to 250 million units annually and create about 240 jobs. Production is set to begin in phases, with the first phase launching in early 2027.

item.title: Prepared Seafood Swims Into Spotlight
item.description: From chili lime shrimp and salmon burgers to ghost pepper tuna packets and smoked salmon candy, processors are casting wider nets for adventurous shoppers. With protein, omega-3s and Gen Z appeal in focus, seafood is staking a bigger claim across the retail store.

item.title: Marzetti Launches Simply Dressed Line
item.description: Marzetti debuts Simply Dressed, a refreshed lineup replacing its Simply dressings line. The new offerings emphasize clean ingredients and flavor-forward formulations.

item.title: Javvy Coffee Launches Clear Protein Refreshers
item.description: Javvy Coffee is expanding its protein lineup with Clear Protein Refreshers, combining protein, caffeine and electrolytes in a lighter format. The new offering delivers functional benefits without artificial ingredients or added sugar

item.title: Danone to Acquire Complete Nutrition Brand Huel
item.description: Danone is acquiring Huel to strengthen its position in functional nutrition and tap into rising demand for complete meal solutions. The deal pairs Huel’s digital-first model with Danone’s global scale to drive growth and innovation

item.title: General Mills Unveils Spring Product Lineup
item.description: General Mills is rolling out a mix of new products and returning favorites for spring, spanning baking mixes, cookies and snacks. The lineup blends indulgent flavors with better-for-you options designed for seasonal moments
